description: This is a Java source file that provides helper methods and classes for integration testing an Eclipse Hono-based system. It includes utilities for managing test environment resources, connecting to various services, sending commands to devices, and handling JSON containment assertions.

classes.name: IntegrationTestSupport
classes.description: A utility class providing methods and constants for setting up and managing integration tests for an Eclipse Hono-based system, including connection setup, resource cleanup, and command messaging.

methods.name: getMessagingNetworkProperties
methods.description: Creates configuration properties for connecting to the AMQP Messaging Network used in the tests.

methods.name: getAmqpAdapterProperties
methods.description: Creates configuration properties for connecting to the AMQP protocol adapter with specific credentials.

methods.name: getDeviceRegistryProperties
methods.description: Creates configuration properties for connecting to the device registry service.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Constructs a username string based on device ID and tenant ID.
